raised: Own added fund gets no price or rank in the main fund list ("אין מחיר כאן", "עוד לא נאסף")

Interactive Brokers shows "אין נתון" (no data), so the reader can't see the cost of buying the fund through a foreign broker
Fund list is very long, with repetitive near-identical Israeli funds, and the reader's own row gave nothing to compare
Unclear whether the 'לא בחישוב' young-person deals apply to a 24-year-old
Explanation of why some funds have no price at Psagot doesn't help the reader decide
The ads-vs-price-list section isn't relevant (would drop it)
Currency-hedging section with charts and table is confusing; the reader doesn't know what נטרול מט״ח is
Staircase chart starts from MTF at Jerusalem, which the reader never chose; unclear why
Fund name says Swap but lacks the 'עסקת החלף' tag Israeli swap funds get
Doesn't understand '4D'/'4A' in fund names
Doesn't understand jargon: צוברת, עסקת החלף, נאמן, משמרת
Doesn't understand W-8BEN, US estate tax, dividend distribution
'מס רק במכירה' shown in red is confusing (is red bad?)
'יש ספק אם נמכרת שם' leaves it unclear whether the fund can be bought at One Zero/IB
No explanation of why own fund came out about 20,000 ₪ lower (fees or tax?)
Wants one plain sentence comparing own fund with the cheapest, with the reason
Would drop the 'מה הכי משנה' chart
The spot where own fund gets a number is buried at the bottom and should move up
